newsitem.title: USA: IMM mark, Swiss and yen end quiet session higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM mark, Swiss and yen end quiet session higher.

text.p: Jan 30 - IMM marks, Swiss and yen ended higher as the dollar took a breather from recent strength. Traders said action light and consolidative ahead of real GDP on Friday and month-end. Traders also noted full data line-up next week and FOMC meetings, keeping some wary. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
